title: Introduction - Main experiment preparation
body_text:
You are now entering the preparation phase for the Main experiment, which is the last phase of the Introduction. You are about to perform 4 tasks of 10 questions each. These tasks closely resemble those in the main experimental phase and are designed to help you practice and prepare for the main task.

As this is still a training phase, your answers will not be recorded and your score will not count towards your bonus remuneration.
